score_meaning: uncalibrated forest score in 0..1; NOT the probability that a fall happened
csi_format: 52 subcarriers, (I,Q) int pairs, about 84 packets/s, ESP32-S3, 20 MHz, 2.4 GHz
trained_on: WiFall (Zhao et al., arXiv:2412.04783), all 10 people; one room, one transmitter, close range; licence of the data is not stated, data not redistributed

evaluation.protocol: leave-one-person-out over the 10 WiFall people, same hyper-parameters as the exported model

limitations: On a person the model has not seen it catches about 2 falls in 3 and falsely flags about 28% of non-falls.
Measured only on WiFall (one room, one transmitter). Accuracy on other hardware or rooms is unknown.
A fall can only ever be reported as a possible fall that needs human verification.
